name: jairf-art-style
description: JAIRF art style roadmap (per 01_Art_Style_Guide.md). Stylized Fantasy: readable silhouettes, exaggerated-but-believable proportions, clear material definition. Palette: warm earth primary, magical purple/gold/cyan accents, desaturated red/orange danger. Soft GI + strong key lights, sparse emissive. Forbidden: realism gore, extreme photorealism, busy noise. Generator keyword: 'stylized fantasy, clean shapes, game-ready, readable silhouette, soft PBR, slightly exaggerated proportions'.
